main_measure.name: slope of demeaned 7-bar forward return on raw 7-day return, trending bars
main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with supporting check), t <= -2 rejects, with at least 100 independent cases

supporting_check.name: timing part of book's mean daily gain above 0

decided_by: The slope's t is 2 or more with at least 100 independent cases and the timing gain is above 0.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0,7,14,... of each window kept when regime is 'trending' with a 7-bar forward return inside the window, the coin mean is the mean of all its grid 7-bar returns over all windows, the book of each coin is its postRebalance_total_value at each day's last bar averaged across coins per day, and the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' is reported as not observable.

direction_check.why: no check fold (the plan has none, or the backtest did not run on its folds)
